title: 003. Group Anagrams
prompt: Given an array of strings `strs`, group the anagrams together. You can return the answer in any order. Achieve `O(N · K)` time using a 26-letter canonical frequency signature.

hints.title: Mental Model & Intuition
hints.content: Sorting each word takes `O(K log K)`. Instead, stamp each word with a 26-slot frequency barcode (`a`..`z`) in a single `O(K)` pass so all anagrams collide in the exact same hash bucket.

hints.title: Pattern Identification
hints.content: Map each canonical 26-count signature to a bucket list: `buckets = defaultdict(list)` in Python, or `Map<String, List<String>>` in Java.

hints.title: Algorithmic Invariant
hints.content: In Python, lists are mutable and unhashable, so convert `count` to `tuple(count)` before indexing `buckets`. In Java, prefix each count with `'#'` (`#1#0#2...`) so multi-digit counts never collide.

hints.title: Edge Cases & Scaffolding
hints.content: Test empty strings `[""]`, single-character strings `["a"]`, and arrays where all words are distinct.
